notes.title: Patch notes v 0.77.20
notes.notes:
New & Improved

Main menu: Apply, Fullscreen and Cancel are now localized.

Added a Cosmic Style for kiosks — unlocked through a special upgrade combination.

Customer attraction now depends on the upgrade levels of Shelf, Roof, Stand, and Counter.

Added preview animations in the Customization menu.

New story intro involving the son.

Fix: Buy a kiosk by holding the LMB, instead of clicking.

Added intractable Mailbox
[p align="start"]Gameplay Changes

You can no longer clean the counter or graffiti while holding a box.

Customers cannot be lured while you are holding a box.
[p align="start"]Audio

Added sounds for:

Purchasing shelves and layers.

Buying visual upgrades.

Expanding storage.

notes.title: Zombie Weekend Update — Zombies Can Hurt You Now!
notes.notes:
🧟‍♂️ Zombie Weekend just got deadlier!

Zombies are no longer harmless background danger — they can hurt you now.



HP System. You start the night with 10 hearts. Every hit from a zombie removes 1 heart. Lose enough, and you’ll be in real trouble.



Too Close = Damage. Keep your distance. If they get in hugging range, you pay the price.



The Night Changes Everything. The red moon rises, eerie fog drifts in, and regular customers vanish. Automation takes a break — it’s on you to keep things under control.



Smart survival tips

Stock up. Make sure your shelves aren’t empty.

Keep moving. Don’t let the dead box you in near corners.

Mind your route. Always have a clear path back to safety.

Watch your hearts. A greedy detour can cost you precious HP.

Will you survive the night and keep your kiosk safe?

notes.title: Update: Charm Nearby Customers With a Subtle "Psst"!
notes.notes:
We've added a brand-new attraction mechanic:
When a customer is wandering nearby, you can press \[E] to make a subtle sound — a gentle cough, a polite "mmm?", or a quiet "ah!" — and try to lure them toward your kiosk.

🎯 If your kiosk has matching products, and luck is on your side, the customer will stop, reconsider... and join your queue!

This isn’t some crude finger snap or catcall. Our in-game voice prompts are respectful, charming, and fully localized. Want more styles of "psst"? Tell us on the forums!

🎁 What's included in this update:

✅ 6 elegant voice cues added (psst, hmm, ah, cough, etc.)

✅ Raycast-based interaction: point at the customer and press \[E]

✅ Customers will evaluate nearby kiosks for matching items before responding

✅ UI hint system added for clarity

✅ No physical colliders used — elegant and optimized
[hr][/hr]💡 Pro Tip:
If your kiosk is clean and stocked, customers are more likely to respond.
Otherwise… they may just keep walking 👀
